Valrasian

Biography

Valrasian is the governor of the Ingos province visited by Zak. A collector of rare objects, he shows more interest in a beautiful arrow than in the murder it may explain. He has the guards answer for the theft from his collection. Zak can exploit this enthusiasm for valuables to obtain permission to enter the closed mines. [1, 2]
